# ExploreLearning Gizmos

> > Interactive math and science simulations aligned to NGSS and state standards for grades 3-12, featuring virtual labs and inquiry-based STEM education.

ExploreLearning Gizmos provides over 550+ virtual simulations for mathematics and science education, including popular tools like the Circuit Builder Gizmo, Cell Division Gizmo, and Forest Ecosystem Gizmo. The platform supports state-specific standards alignment and assessment preparation, including ISASP for Iowa and standards for Nevada and Rhode Island.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- STEM Cases
- Virtual labs and simulations
- Grades 3-12 education
- Inquiry-based learning
- State standards alignment
- High school science (grades 9-12)
- Math simulations
- Science simulations
- ISASP preparation
- Circuit Builder Gizmo
- Cell Division Gizmo
- Forest Ecosystem Gizmo
- STEM education
- Interactive learning tools

## High School Science Resources

- [Science Gizmos for Grades 9-12](https://gizmos.explorelearning.com/science-gizmos-grades-9-to-12): High school science simulations (grades 9-12) with NGSS-aligned content

## State Standards Alignment

- [ExploreLearning Gizmos + Iowa](https://gizmos.explorelearning.com/iowa): Iowa-aligned Gizmos for ISASP preparation and state standards
- [ExploreLearning Gizmos + Nevada](https://gizmos.explorelearning.com/nevada): Nevada Student Learning Standards-aligned math and science simulations
- [ExploreLearning Gizmos + Rhode Island](https://gizmos.explorelearning.com/rhode-island): Rhode Island standards-aligned Gizmos with NGSS science simulations
